business_summary: Vertiv Holdings Co is a NYSE-listed supplier of critical digital infrastructure: uninterruptible power supplies, switchgear, busbar, integrated power blocks and thermal management including liquid cooling, sold into hyperscale, colocation and enterprise data centres. Unlike the diversified industrials in this batch, its end market is the data centre itself, so its revenue line and the chain's demand are close to the same series.

exposure_summary.narrative: Vertiv sits on two links: power-equipment, the money corner, and liquid-cooling. Both placements are backed by dated product evidence, the PowerNexus launch for the power block and the 2025 Form 10-K for liquid-cooled thermal management. It is the most direct exposure in the batch and, for the same reason, the one where the un-crowded premise is weakest: an issuer whose entire business is the data centre is the first name a data-centre thesis reaches for.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: Vertiv does not publish a data-centre revenue percentage because its disclosed business is critical digital infrastructure as a whole; the fetched second-quarter 2026 release (accession 0001628280-26-050323) reports consolidated net sales and segment geography, not an end-market split.

crowdedness_caveats: This is the one issuer in this batch that already carries a Stocky dive at data/stocks/VRT__ai-infrastructure.json, which is itself evidence the name is not undiscovered inside this repo, let alone outside it.
data/market/VRT.json pcs records 26 analysts and 84.4% institutional ownership as of 2026-08-29, axis-B SATURATED, axis-A DARK at 88.2 under an ADVISORY gate.

The 52-week range in the same file runs 121.82 to 376.23 and the last close is 257.08, so the stock is roughly a third below its own high. A drawdown is not the same thing as being un-crowded; it is a crowded position that has been hurt.
Its price-to-sales and EV-to-sales ratios computed here are the highest in the batch by a factor of about five against Powell and MYR Group, which is what discovered pure-play exposure costs.

confidence_audit.basis: Counts cover the canonical metric fields only. VERIFIED is a figure read directly off SEC companyfacts as reported. INFERRED is a figure computed from SEC companyfacts, with the derivation named in its basis; where a market price enters the computation the basis says so explicitly, because the price leg is the repo's own dual-source market plane (data/market/VRT.json, price_status AGREED) and not an issuer document. SPECULATIVE is reserved for the reverse-DCF solve, whose discount rate and terminal growth are assumed. NULL is a field looked for and not found, never estimated.
